  JOIN credit_and_compliance cc ON ba.bankexpref = cc.compbankref
  JOIN credit_accounts_and_history ca ON cc.compbankref = ca.histcompref
),
with_metrics AS (
  SELECT *,
    -- Cohort start date = scoredate - tenureyrs years
    (scoredate::date - INTERVAL '1 year' * tenureyrs) as start_date,
    -- Digital native: onlineuse='High' OR mobileuse='High', AND autopay='Yes'
    (onlineuse = 'High' OR mobileuse = 'High') AND autopay = 'Yes' as is_digital_native,

)
